body: Symptom: building apps/website failed with 'Could not resolve ../../../../examples/chart-full.md?raw'. Cause: when playground/examples/index.ts was copied from apps/playground/src/examples/ → apps/website/src/playground/examples/, the nesting got one level deeper (apps/website/src/playground/examples vs apps/playground/src/examples), so all 17 ?raw imports needed an extra ../. Fix: sed 's|../../../../examples/|../../../../../examples/|g' index.ts. RULE: any file move involving Vite ?raw/?url imports must adjust depth of the relative path; tsc won't catch it (raw imports aren't part of TS module resolution) — only the bundler errors out. Add a quick post-move grep for ?raw to catch this next time.
title: Vite ?raw imports break when files are relocated — paths are relative-to-source, not workspace
